No animation,skin,morph,unsupported extensions or ambiguous scene.

format.images: Admitted PNG/JPEG bufferView or canonical data:image/png;base64, / data:image/jpeg;base64, URI, never both. Unchanged integrity/decode/Exif orientation/color-role/pixel rules.
